description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_3DPrinting" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-printing">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeInstructions" name="Change instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DPrinting">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_User" name="Customer" processRef="Process_User"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Send sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialSTL" name="Send STL" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Send change instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Participant_Artist" messageRef="Message_ChangeInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedSTL" name="Send revised STL" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Send printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Start_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_User" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches to the artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL from the artist" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfaction" name="Satisfied with the result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell the artist what to change" messageRef="Message_ChangeInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose a plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Color at home?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderColor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check how much color is left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Under 100 grams?">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AddToList</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnoughColor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToShoppingList" name="Put color on the shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order the color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorAvailable" name="Plastic available"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and generate G-code"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from the STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer and G-code ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ModelPrinted" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrinterStatus" name="Receive ongoing printer status" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrinterStatus" name="Status received"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusReceived" sourceRef="Start_PrinterStatus" targetRef="End_PrinterStatus"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SendSketches" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendSketches_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSTL_Satisfaction" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfaction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfaction_Changes" name="Not satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfaction" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Changes_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfaction_ChooseColor" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfaction" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseColor_InStock" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">color is at home</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderColor" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_OrderColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAmount_Under100" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddToList" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddToShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">remaining color is under 100 grams</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnoughColor" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_ColorAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_List_ColorAvailable" sourceRef="Task_AddToShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_ColorAvailable" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAvailable_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Heat" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_Gcode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Heat_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gcode_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_Print" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Print_End" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_ModelPrinted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock_CheckAmount" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100_AddToList" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddToShoppingList"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
